tickets.title: US001: Drag and Drop Classes to Calendar
tickets.description:
s a Student, I want to drag and drop classes into a visual calendar, so that I can easily see if the course times fit my schedule without manual tracking.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Verify that the user can drag a course from the catalog sidebar and drop it onto a calendar day/time slot.
- [ ] Verify that dropping a course successfully renders it visually on the calendar grid.
- [ ] Verify that the user can remove a course from the calendar to free up the time slot.

tickets.title: US002: Early Morning Class Warning
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to receive an immediate warning when adding an 8:00 AM class to my calendar, so that I can avoid oversleeping and missing lectures.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Verify that a prominent visual warning notification appears immediately when a class starting at exactly 8:00 AM is added to the calendar.
- [ ] Verify that the warning does not block the user from adding the class, but explicitly mentions the risk of oversleeping.

tickets.title: US003: Real-time Course Availability Validation
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want the system to block me from adding a class that is already full according to the live database, so that I do not plan a roadmap around unavailable slots.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Verify that the system fetches real-time enrollment data from the registrar database when a user attempts to add a class.
- [ ] Verify that if a class has zero open slots, an error message is displayed and the course cannot be committed to the active schedule.

tickets.title: US004: Manual Prerequisite Override
tickets.description:
As an Administrator, I want to manually override prerequisite restrictions for a specific student, so that I can grant special permission to students with exceptional cases.

Acceptance Criteria:
- [ ] Verify that an authorized advisor account has an "Override Prerequisite" button available on a student's profile.
- [ ] Verify that triggering the override bypasses the automated system blocks and allows the course assignment to be saved.

analysis.ambiguity1: The course catalog is ugly. I just want to drag and drop classes into a calendar to see if they fit. I want the app to warn me if I am choosing a class that starts at 8:00 AM because I will definitely oversleep.
analysis.ambiguity2: Student data is sensitive. Under no circumstances should a student be able to see another student schedule. Also, the system must log every time an advisor manually overrides a prerequisite for audit purposes.
analysis.conflictSolution:
Conflict: The Head of Advising wants students to be able to plan their roadmaps 4 years ahead regardless of course availability, whereas the Registrar states that students shouldn't be able to add a class if it is already full according to the live database.

Proposed Solution: Allow students to add any course to their long-term roadmap as a "Draft/Planned" status for future semesters. However, for the current or upcoming registration term, the system will validate against the live database; if a class is full, it will display a visual warning or add the student to a waiting list rather than blocking long-term planning.
analysis.nfr1: The system must guarantee strict data privacy so that students are completely restricted from viewing any other student's academic roadmap or schedule.
analysis.nfr2: The system must maintain a comprehensive and immutable log of all manual prerequisite overrides executed by advisors for auditing and compliance purposes.
analysis.nfr3: The system must seamlessly integrate and synchronize with the university's live registration database to ensure real-time course availability checks during active scheduling.
